locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the physical logarithmic interval is [-log(lambda),log(lambda)]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(y)*exp(-i*t*y) dy and Plancherel measure is dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is included
locked_conventions.inversion: multiplicatively Jf(u)=f(u^(-1)); in the additive logarithmic coordinate Jf(y)=f(-y)
locked_conventions.source_normalization: all prolate combinations use the source zero-Lebesgue-integral normalization, never unit normalization
locked_conventions.strictness: equality in zeta<1, theta_soft<1, or a positive source floor is a rejection
locked_conventions.finite_parity: Fourier residue class is not identified with inversion parity at finite lambda; the actual projected pole representer is used
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: p and dps label exact rational theorem-regression models, not physical prolate--Weil pilot matrices or an asymptotic schedule
locked_conventions.arithmetic: all matrices, factorizations, contractions, and reserves are exact reduced rationals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.source_metric: Delta=(A*A^*)^dagger on K and G=A^*Psoft*A; the scalar base is g*A^*A, never g*I unless A is an isometry
locked_formulas.scalar_schedule_test: if norm(Z)<=1-delta and norm(Ytilde*Psoft^(-1/2))^2<=(1-tau)*delta then D_B>=delta*g*I and S_B>=tau*Psoft
locked_formulas.full_gap: with G>=alpha*I and chi=norm(D_B^(-1/2)*B_HK*Delta^(-1/2)), B>=min(tau*alpha,1)/(1+chi)^2*(Delta direct_sum D_B)
